newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle steady at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle steady at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.

Sales reported on 4,300 slaughter steers and 2,200 heifers; 70,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,500 formulated and 2,100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 72.00. Pen Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1300 lbs 72.50. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 71.00. Slaughter Heifers -
